decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already fully records the change from three trial clips to one reference-matching corrective clip and removes the obsolete deadline.
The revised qualification step does not change the existing requirement for 125 approved clips per month.
The same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete constraint that all three trial clips come from one video; no further source-selection change is entailed.
Requesting one clip that matches the reference changes the qualification method but does not alter the existing clean-editing standards.
The source does not establish a new moment-selection standard; matching the reference is the qualification condition.
The source does not cancel or modify the existing requirement for a complete standalone teaching moment.
The source does not specify any change to caption color, font, or effects.
Reducing the qualification submission to one clip does not change the required 30-to-90-second duration.
The promise to create a ticket after a successful corrective clip does not change the channel or content used to submit clips for review.
